entries.source: Ubhejane Site and Sector maps can show the before-works archive photograph.

drafts.zu: Amamephu eSite neSector ase-Ubhejane angabonisa isithombe senqolobane sangaphambi komsebenzi.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa Site le Sector tsa Ubhejane di ka bontsha foto ya polokelo ya pele ho mesebetsi.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya Site na Sector ya Ubhejane yi nga komba xifaniso xa khale xa le mahlweni ka mintirho.
drafts.ve: Mapa a Site na Sector a Ubhejane a nga sumbedza tshifanyiso tsha kale tsha musi mishumo i sa athu thoma.

entries.source: AI maps start with available aerial imagery; you can still choose plain paper.

drafts.zu: Amamephu e-AI aqala ngezithombe zasemoyeni ezikhona; usengakhetha iphepha elimhlophe.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa AI di qala ka ditshwantsho tse teng tsa moyeng; o ntse o ka kgetha pampiri e tshweu.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya AI yi sungula hi swifaniso leswi kumekaka swa le henhla; wa ha nga hlawula phepha ro basa.
drafts.ve: Mapa a AI a thoma nga zwifanyiso zwi re hone zwa nṱha; ni kha ḓi nga nanga bammbiri ḽitshena.
